description: A festival director must finalize whether a submitted film enters the national competition or the panorama program and must lock the exact screening master and catalog status before the program goes to press.

shared_context.S1: The festival has accepted the film 'Glass Harbor' for consideration in either the national competition or the panorama program.
shared_context.S2: National-competition entries must be national premieres and must run no longer than 90 minutes.
shared_context.S3: Panorama entries do not require a national premiere and may use the festival's approved screening master.
shared_context.S4: The current catalog draft lists 'Glass Harbor' as 94 minutes, with its premiere status still marked for confirmation.
shared_context.S5: Mara makes the final programming and delivery decision, and the festival's routine pre-publication check-in asks submissions and technical screening staff to report any status or master-file issues.

PF1.text: Jonah checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country; he recorded the result in his local review notes, but the database export feeding Mara's catalog review has not refreshed.

PF2.text: Elise completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94-minute catalog draft; the QC report is waiting in the technical queue and has not yet been attached to the programming record.

acceptance_conditions: The film must be placed in the panorama program because it is not a national premiere.
The screening runtime must be set to exactly 88 minutes.
The approved 88-minute festival DCP must be selected as the screening master.
The film must be marked not eligible for the national competition.
A premiere-status catalog update must be logged.
An ingest-record or QC-report attachment update for the 88-minute DCP must be logged.

content_checks.C3: decisions['screening_master'] in ['Approved 88-minute festival DCP', 'approved festival cut DCP', 'approved 88-minute festival DCP', 'approved 88-minute DCP']
content_checks.C5: decisions['catalog_premiere_status'] in ['Previously screened nationally', 'not a national premiere', 'not a national premiere (prior public screening at Coastline Film Week confirmed)']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['premiere_status_update', 'catalog_update', 'catalog_correction', 'record_refresh', 'database_refresh'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['ingest-record update', 'ingest_record_update', 'dcp_ingest_update', 'record_attachment', 'delivery_instruction', 'technical_documentation', 'technical_record_update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed Coastline Film Week screening changes the film from a possible national-competition entry to panorama, changes national_competition_eligible to False, changes the catalog status to either 'Previously screened nationally' or 'not a national premiere', and requires a premiere-status catalog update.
The ingest QC result changes screening_runtime_minutes from the catalog draft's 94 to exactly 88, selects an approved festival-cut DCP, and requires an ingest-record or QC-report attachment update.
